{{Youmay|the geographical term|[[Vast Veldt]], a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]]}}
A '''veldt''' was a plain located in a particularly hot [[Temperature/Legends|climate]]. They typically supported more life than cooler [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
Veldts were the natural habitats of [[early death dog]]s.<ref name="MAGL">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}

==Behind the scenes==
Veldts were first mentioned in ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a book published in [[1993]].<ref name="MAGL" /> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in the book is [[Canon|non-canonical]].<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon? Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}}</ref>

In real life, the term [[Wikipedia:veld|veld]], sometimes spelled veldt in English, is a generic term used to define certain wide open rural spaces of [[Wikipedia:Southern Africa|Southern Africa]].
